info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Recordings-v5-spec
info.description: The Meetings Recordings API allows users to access and retrieve detailed recordings of past meetings. This endpoint serves business professionals who need to review and reference meeting discussions, enabling enhanced collaboration and record-keeping. By providing easy access to audio and video recordings, it supports effective decision-making and accountability within organizations. Typical consumers include team leaders, project managers, and administrative staff looking to track meeting outcomes and share insights with stakeholders.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch recordings of meetings from the system. Utilize this operation to access valuable meeting outcomes and references.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving meeting recordings. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the schema to successfully fetch the recordings.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operations related to meeting recordings. It is expected to be a string.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the meeting recording.

state.description: Current state of the meeting recording process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Human-readable message providing additional context about the operation.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsResponse_2.description: Response schema for the operation to get meeting recording status.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information regarding the audit history of the meeting recording.

x-processing-time.description: The time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing was completed without noticeable delay.
